Meridian Credits release 1.0 credit agreement (finance-approved in issue trial-351, 2026-09-07; statement-total command approved in issue trial-eio, 2026-09-08). Applies to all Meridian Credits quote and total requests naming release 1.0; the current agreement is 1.0, so an omitted release selects 1.0. Versions introduced in an issue remain supported afterward.

Credit rules per request (a request is the complete charge set of one independently quoted monthly statement; caps apply within that set):
- Uncapped credit per line: 10% of charge_cents, rounded down separately per line to integer cents (integer arithmetic charge_cents // 10).
- Cap: 2400 cents shared by ALL lines with the same account_id, across its subscriptions; distinct account_id groups have independent caps.
- Assignment priority within a cap group: earliest service_on first; equal service dates use increasing line_id (lexicographic = Unicode code-point order).
- Each line receives its uncapped credit up to the group remaining cap; later lines receive only the remainder, or zero.
- Totals: total credit = sum of assigned line credits; per-line amount due = charge - assigned credit; total due = total charges - total credit.

One-line quote contract (trial-351): request {"command":"quote","line":LINE} or same with "release":"1.0"; response has exactly release, line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; the supplied line is treated as the entire statement. Example: charge 19999 -> credit 1999, due 18000.

Statement total contract (trial-eio): request {"command":"total","lines":[LINE,...]} or same with "release":"1.0"; response has exactly release, credit_cents, amount_due_cents for the whole supplied charge set under this agreement's shared-cap scope; it is NOT a collection of independent single-line quotes. Empty lines -> {"release":"1.0","credit_cents":0,"amount_due_cents":0}; a statement of only the quote example line (charge 19999) -> credit 1999, due 18000. The quote command remains available and unchanged.

Line schema constraints: exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id, service_on, charge_cents; IDs nonempty strings; line_id unique within a request; subscription identified by (account_id, subscription_id) pair; service_on valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD in 2020-01-01..2099-12-31; charge_cents nonnegative integer US cents; no line excluded by service date; line collections may be empty; JSON key order immaterial; no response keys beyond those specified.

CLI contract: python3 main.py reads one JSON object on stdin, writes exactly one JSON object on stdout. {"command":"ping"} -> {"status":"ok","product":"Meridian Credits"}; unknown command -> {"error":"unknown_command"}. No network/clock/locale/third-party packages; malformed input out of scope.

Implementation notes beyond the agreement text (inference, not finance-approved): main.py implements the full multi-line assignment (assign_credits) so the shared-cap priority order is available to later commands; a release value outside SUPPORTED_RELEASES returns {"error":"unsupported_release"} for quote and total alike. For a single account group the total assigned credit equals min(sum of per-line uncapped credits, 2400) regardless of assignment order, because greedy assignment saturates the cap; priority order still governs per-line assignment.

Verification (2026-09-08): public suites public_tests/release_1_quote.json and public_tests/release_1_total.json pass (python3 test_public.py --cases); local tests tests/test_quote.py, tests/test_total.py (empty statement, omitted release, shared cap across lines, independent caps per account, same subscription_id under different accounts, several lines of one subscription, floor rounding, zero charges, unsupported release), and tests/test_smoke.py all pass.

Source: issues trial-351 and trial-eio quoting the finance-approved release 1.0 agreement and the approved statement-total contract.
